title: adrs.changed.v1 data
description: The decision records of a repository, or the list, changed. Subject: `<owner>/<repo>` is the repository root identity; `list` is the identity of the view the signal invalidates, not a root (named exception to EVT-1, see docs/contracts/events.md; a domain fact would be a new versioned type with a root id as subject, #663).
